description.en: Turns a low-detail cutscene character model to face a given world position, over a number of frames — combines GetRyLookAtPos with CMND_CHR_TURN_TRG.
Handle of the character model to turn.
3-element target position [x, y, z] to face.
Number of frames the turn should take.
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Turn a character to face a target position over 20 frames
EvLowMdlSetLookAtPos(hTenmaL, _pos, 20);
